product_goal: Provide reliable validation of smart-meter readings before billing.

stories.title: Validate meter-reading JSON
stories.benefit: prevent malformed data from entering billing
acceptance_criteria: Valid JSON readings pass schema validation

stories.title: Provide actionable validation errors
stories.goal: understand why a reading was rejected
acceptance_criteria: Each rejected reading includes an error reason
Valid readings do not generate validation errors

stories.title: Detect duplicate meter events
acceptance_criteria: The first occurrence of an event ID is accepted
Repeated event IDs are identified as duplicates
Duplicate events do not increase consumption totals

stories.title: View rejected readings
stories.goal: see invalid meter readings in one place
acceptance_criteria: Rejected readings are displayed in a list
Each record shows meter ID and error reason
Agents can filter results by meter ID

stories.title: Calculate electricity charges
acceptance_criteria: Charges are calculated using configured tariffs
Billing results are displayed with a breakdown
